summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The AQE Core ETF (AQEC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund actively manages a global portfolio of large-cap equities. AQEC was launched on Nov 18, 2025 and is issued by Arlington.

holdings.infoBox: AQEC is an equity ETF with a total of 133 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 8.03%, Apple at 7.65%, Microsoft at 5.79%, Alphabet at 5.61%, and Amazon.com at 3.22%.
